rationale: C07 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. The child expressly adopts the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States, 1951 prescribed by C07 and uses a closely parallel savings provision preserving prosecution, punishment, and completion of preexisting matters as though the new order had not issued. C03 and C18 contain related earlier manual-adoption and transition machinery, but C07 is the direct and closest source.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Manual for Courts-Martial, United States, 1951, and modifications or revisions thereof, shall govern the conduct of courts-martial in the Public Health Service.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This manual shall be in force and effect in the armed forces of the United States on and after May 31, 1951
shared_material.explanation: Both make the same 1951 manual the governing court-martial framework, with the child adapting its coverage to the Public Health Service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All offenses committed and all penalties, forfeitures, fines, or liabilities incurred prior to the date of this order ... may be prosecuted, punished, and enforced, and action thereon may be completed, in the same manner and with the same effect as if this order had not been issued.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any investigation, trial, or action so begun may be completed in accordance with the provisions of the applicable laws, Executive orders, and regulations ... in the same manner and with the same effect as if this manual had not been prescribed
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive parallel transition language preserving earlier proceedings and liabilities despite adoption of the new military-justice regime.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Uniform Code of Military Justice is hereby adapted to apply to officers of the Commissioned Corps of the Public Health Service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In the manual the Uniform Code of Military Justice is referred to as "the code."
shared_material.explanation: The child extends the specific military-justice system implemented through C07 to a new service and supplies corresponding institutional substitutions.
